description: This file provides LLDB debugger commands and utilities for inspecting PyTorch C++ types, including context managers to disable breakpoints and summary functions for IntArrayRef, DispatchKeyset, and Tensor objects. It also initializes LLDB type summaries for these types.

classes.name: DisableBreakpoints
classes.description: Context manager to temporarily disable all LLDB breakpoints during evaluation of expressions.

methods.name: get_target
methods.description: Retrieves the current LLDB target, with error handling if no target is available.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Disables all breakpoints when entering the context.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Re-enables all breakpoints when exiting the context.

methods.name: IntArrayRef_summary
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string summary of a c10::IntArrayRef object.

methods.name: DispatchKeyset_summary
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string summary of a c10::DispatchKeyset object.

methods.name: Tensor_summary
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string summary of an at::Tensor object.

methods.name: __lldb_init_module
methods.description: Initializes LLDB type summaries for PyTorch types and prints usage instructions.
